home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.lost.q: What if I lose my phone?
home.faq.lost.a: Your identity isn't tied to one device. Your Master Key or Recovery Sheet restores everything on a new device, and you can freeze your cards instantly.
home.faq.compare.q: How is ROUT different from Linktree or Google Sign-In?
home.faq.compare.a: Linktree is a list of links; Google Sign-In shares your data with Google. ROUT combines profile, pass and sign-in, and every app gets its own anonymous code so apps can't track you across each other.
home.faq.metal.q: How does the metal card with dual QR work?
home.faq.metal.a: The printed QR only shows your public profile and never grants access. Real access runs via NFC or a rotating code in your Wallet, so a photo of your card is worthless.
home.faq.free.a: Teams and businesses pay for workspaces, so we never need to sell your data.
